newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada sells 16,000 ounces of gold in October. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Canada sells 16,000 ounces of gold in October. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]

text.p: Canada sold 16,000 ounces of gold in October, bringing reserves to 3.1 million ounces as of October 31, the Finance Department said on Tuesday.
The gold was held at a book value of US$0.8 million and added US$6.5 million to the international reserves. (Corrects from "US$9.7 million" to "US$6.5 million".)
The Canadian government has a policy of gradually selling off its gold reserves and replacing them with interest-bearing assets.
